<h2>Load the VegVault Database Version Record</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reads the current release record from the 'version_control' table of a
VegVault SQLite file, opened read-only, and stops with an error unless
its version equals the configured VegVault version.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_vegvault_database_version(
  path_to_vegvault = here::here("Data/Input/VegVault.sqlite"),
  vegvault_version
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="path_to_vegvault">path_to_vegvault</code></td>
<td>
<p>A character string with the path to the VegVault SQLite database
(default: 'here::here(&quot;Data/Input/VegVault.sqlite&quot;)').</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vegvault_version">vegvault_version</code></td>
<td>
<p>A single non-empty character string, the VegVault version the project
is configured for ('vegvault_data.vegvault_version' in 'config.yml'),
for example '&quot;2.0.0&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The current release is the row with the highest 'id' among the rows
that have a version, as in 'vaultkeepr::open_vault()'. The id decides,
not the text order of the version, in which '&quot;2.10.0&quot;' comes before
'&quot;2.9.0&quot;'.
</p>
<p>Unlike vaultkeepr, which reads such a file as VegVault 1.0.0, a file
without a 'version_control' table or without any version row stops
with an error: the release record is provenance and must come from the
file itself.
</p>
<p>A version that differs from 'vegvault_version' stops with an error of
class 'biodynamics_vegvault_version_mismatch'.
</p>
<p>The connection is opened with 'RSQLite::SQLITE_RO', so the file is
never written. The record holds no path and no time stamp, so it is the
same in every checkout of the same file. An always-cued target built
from it changes only when the database release changes.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A one-row tibble with three character columns:
</p>

<ul>
<li><p> 'vegvault_version': the version of the current release, equal
to 'vegvault_version'.
</p>
</li>
<li><p> 'git_commit': the VegVault commit the file was built from.
</p>
</li>
<li><p> 'manifest_sha256': the SHA-256 of the build manifest.
</p>
</li></ul>

<p>'git_commit' and 'manifest_sha256' are 'NA' when the table has no such
column (VegVault before 2.0.0) or no value in the current row.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[build_vegvault_plan()]
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
load_vegvault_database_version(
  path_to_vegvault = here::here("Data/Input/VegVault.sqlite"),
  vegvault_version = "2.0.0"
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
